rules.comment: Lunatone 327 vs three Dark types that only switch: six stat moves put Sp. Def at +6 (Sp. Atk lower), then Calm Mind scores -8
Minun 292 Charm vs Hyper Cutter Pinsir 369 (single ability): runs in the first AI turn
player's Walrein sets Hail turn 1; AI Rapidash 515 scores Bounce in Hail from turn 2 (player never uses Protect)
AI Dewgong 488 vs slower Registeel spamming Amnesia/Rest (encouraged last move): 12 percent roll per undisabled turn over ~25 turns
AI Machamp 810 vs three Ghosts it cannot hit: needs its Substitute and a successful Attract (opposite gender, 3 tries); then the 61 percent roll gives +5
AI Armaldo 513 vs Meganium using Substitute each turn until below 30 percent HP
AI Misdreavus 374 toxic + seeded by slower Ludicolo 688 (kept at 80 percent+): about 40 percent HP at turn 4; piece 1 runs from turn 1
AI Machamp 811 vs Lapras 822 using Rest (no Chesto): asleep target gives Revenge -2
AI Gengar 613 Skill Swap vs Shiftry (Chlorophyll/Early Bird) then Houndoom, Ludicolo: 20 percent roll per guessed encouraged ability; depends on the player's ability slot varying with the seed
AI Gengar 613 Skill Swap vs Arena Trap Dugtrio 564: turn 1; only when the player's Dugtrio has ability slot Arena Trap (about half the seeds if the lab's player personalities vary with the seed)
